short.zh: 把一次学习，变成能独立完成的工作。
short.en: Learn an agent. Put it to work.

audience.zh: 企业团队、创业者与个人学习者

problem.zh: 工具学过不少，回到真实工作却不知道如何开始。
problem.en: You have tried the tools, but need a practical way to use them in your own work.

description.zh: 围绕你的真实场景定制课程，从入门、中阶到高阶，把智能体用进实际任务。
description.en: Hands-on learning built around your real tasks, from the first workflow to more advanced agent use.

zh: 场景诊断与分级学习安排
智能体配置与工作流练习
一个可演示的实际任务成果
课件、练习与复盘建议
en: A task-based learning plan at the right level
Agent setup and workflow exercises
A demonstrable piece of practical work
Learning materials, exercises and review notes

start.zh: 带一个想用 AI 完成的任务来。
start.en: Bring one task you want to complete with AI.

zh: 确认场景、基础与学习目标
约定工具、课时与课程安排
边学边做，完成场景练习
演示成果，明确下一步训练
en: Define the task and learning goal
Agree on tools, sessions and schedule
Build and practise during the workshop
Review the work and plan the next steps

timing.zh: 按需求安排；可按每月 4 课时持续学习。
timing.en: Scheduled to fit your needs. A four-session monthly format is available.

pricing.zh: 标准课程：299 元 / 课时；1,200 元 / 月（4 课时）。企业定制与多人拼课按范围报价。
pricing.en: International pricing on request. Team workshops are scoped separately.

q.en: Can I join with no experience?

a.zh: 可以。先了解你的工作任务与基础，再确定入门、中阶或高阶安排。
a.en: Yes. We agree on the right level after a short discussion about your work and experience.

q.zh: 工具账号费用包含在课程里吗？

a.zh: 所需工具、账号与相关费用在排期前说明，并单独确认。
a.en: Required accounts, subscriptions and any additional costs are agreed before scheduling.

short.zh: 让 AI 落地，从一号位的真实工作开始。
short.en: Make AI useful at the top of the business.

audience.zh: 老板、创始人与业务一号位

problem.zh: 知道 AI 重要，却难以判断先做什么、怎么配置、如何带动团队。
problem.en: You see the opportunity, but need help choosing where to start and bringing the team with you.

description.zh: 从一号位亲自使用出发，梳理硬件与工具、智能体配置、工作架构和使用界面，在持续实践中带动组织落地。
description.en: A practical partnership covering tool and hardware choices, agent setup, work architecture and everyday interfaces.

zh: 一号位工作场景与优先级地图
硬件、工具与智能体配置方案
日常工作的使用界面与操作路径
分阶段试点与持续复盘机制
en: A map of leadership tasks and priorities
A hardware, tool and agent setup plan
Practical interfaces and everyday working routines
A phased pilot with ongoing reviews

start.zh: 从一个最耗精力的日常决策或业务任务开始。
start.en: Start with one recurring decision or task that takes too much of your time.

zh: 访谈并梳理一号位工作
选择可验证的小范围试点
配置工具、智能体与使用界面
复盘试点，逐步带入团队
en: Map the leader’s real work
Choose a small, testable pilot
Set up tools, agents and interfaces
Review the pilot and extend it to the team

timing.zh: 按阶段与陪跑频率约定。
timing.en: Phases and meeting frequency are agreed together.

pricing.zh: 按场景、周期与参与范围报价；硬件及第三方订阅另行确认。
pricing.en: Quoted by scope, duration and involvement. Hardware and subscriptions are agreed separately.

q.zh: 一定要先部署全公司的系统吗？
q.en: Do we need a company-wide system first?

a.zh: 从一号位实际使用的小场景切入，验证有用后再逐步扩展。
a.en: We start with a small task the leader actually uses, then expand when it proves useful.

q.zh: 这是一次培训还是长期顾问服务？
q.en: Is this a workshop or an ongoing engagement?

a.zh: 以持续实践与复盘为主，可包含必要培训；周期与边界在合作前约定。
a.en: The focus is implementation and review, with training where needed. Duration and boundaries are agreed upfront.

short.zh: 把分散的能力，组织成运行中的系统。
short.en: Turn separate tools into a working system.

audience.zh: 希望把 AI 带入业务的企业与团队
audience.en: Businesses and teams bringing AI into operations

problem.zh: 工具、知识与流程彼此分散，演示能跑，实际交付却接不起来。
problem.en: Tools, knowledge and processes are disconnected. A good demo does not yet make a reliable operation.

description.zh: 围绕客户场景，把 AI 智能体、知识与工具、业务流程和人的协作组织成一套可运行、可验收的工作系统。
description.en: Bring agents, knowledge, tools, business processes and human collaboration together around a real operating task.

zh: 场景、任务与交付边界清单
智能体、知识与工具的协作架构
约定范围的工作流与使用界面
验收标准、交接说明与改进计划
en: A defined task, scope and delivery checklist
An architecture for agents, knowledge and tools
Agreed workflows and operating interfaces
Acceptance criteria, handover notes and an improvement plan

start.zh: 带一个需要反复交付的业务场景来。
start.en: Bring one business task your team needs to deliver repeatedly.

zh: 理解问题与现有流程
设计系统与最小交付范围
搭建、测试并组织协作
验收、交接与持续改进
en: Understand the task and current process
Design the smallest useful system
Build, test and organise collaboration
Review, hand over and improve

timing.zh: 按系统边界与试点范围确认；长期共建可单独约定。
timing.en: Timing follows the pilot scope. Long-term co-development is available by agreement.

pricing.zh: 按范围报价；长期共同投入、共同发展、共享结果的合作机制单独约定。
pricing.en: Quoted by scope. Long-term investment and shared outcomes are agreed separately.

q.zh: 可以从一个小项目开始吗？

a.zh: 可以。优先选择能明确输入、输出与验收方式的场景，再逐步扩展。
a.en: Yes. We start with a task whose inputs, outputs and acceptance criteria can be defined.

a.zh: 交付时提供约定的使用与维护说明；持续运营、维护和共建范围另行确认。
a.en: Agreed operating and maintenance notes are included. Ongoing support and co-development are scoped separately.
